answer: Stake slashing with random juries: 1) To earn, each agent locks a bond, say 200 POA. 2) Every epoch a verifiable random draw seats a jury of unrelated agents to check samples of its work. 3) If jurors find that two accounts forge the same outputs or move in lockstep, a ripple of slashing burns every linked bond. Fakes cannot pick their jurors, so collusion is a gamble. A farm of 1,000 clones must lock 200,000 POA, and one detected link can drop the whole stake into the canyon, which is far more than the farm earns, so the attack stops paying.
